name: AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional

fee.note: USD list price; taxes may apply. AWS charges set local-currency prices in countries that use the euro (€256), Australian dollar (A$449), Japanese yen (¥40,000), Korean won, Chinese yuan and Indian rupee (vouchers only), updated at least once a year. After you earn one AWS Certification, the next exam is 50% off.

exam.format: 75 multiple choice and multiple response questions, 180 minutes, at a Pearson VUE test center or online proctored. AWS recommends two or more years provisioning, operating and managing AWS environments, plus experience with the software development lifecycle and programming or scripting.

scope: Provisioning, operating and managing distributed systems on AWS: SDLC and CI/CD automation, configuration management and infrastructure as code, resilient solutions, monitoring and logging, incident and event response, and automated security and compliance.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: The Korean version is retired after December 31, 2026.
Passing this exam also renews an active AWS Developer – Associate or CloudOps Engineer (formerly SysOps Administrator) – Associate certification.
